definitions.gloss: formidable enemy; tough opponent; strong rival
definitions.explanation: A powerful adversary or competitor who is difficult to defeat. Used in contexts ranging from warfare and sports to business and everyday challenges.

examples.japanese: {強敵|きょうてき}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう。
{決勝|けっしょう}の{相手|あいて}は{強敵|きょうてき}だった。
examples.english: The opponent in the finals was a tough one.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{商品|しょうひん}は{市場|しじょう}で{多|おお}くの{強敵|きょうてき}と{競|きそ}うことになる。
examples.english: The new product will compete with many formidable rivals in the market.

notes:
Composed of {強|きょう} (strong) + {敵|てき} (enemy, opponent). A versatile word used across many domains — sports, games, business, and literal conflict.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強敵|きょうてき}に{立|た}ち{向|む}かう: to face a formidable foe
- {強敵|きょうてき}を{倒|たお}す: to defeat a strong enemy
- {強敵|きょうてき}が{現|あらわ}れる: a powerful rival appears
- {手強|てごわ}い{強敵|きょうてき}: a tough, formidable opponent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {敵|てき}: enemy, opponent (neutral; not necessarily strong)
- ライバル: rival (often implies mutual respect and ongoing competition)
- {好敵手|こうてきしゅ}: worthy rival (emphasizes being well-matched)
